'''Base Tekar''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military installation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. Located at [[Derilyn Space Central]], it was a major military communications post with a large antenna field. Several large antennas dotted the field, including [[Tower 14]]. Base Tekar was also the location of the [[Imperial Monitoring Garrison]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team, allied with the [[Friends of Paran]], infiltrated Base Tekar as part of a larger plan to destroy the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]''.
